title: Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Recalled by American Honda Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The ROV can lose steering control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 118,600.

title: ADCO Recalls Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Dollar Tree
summary: The candles' high flames can ignite the surface of the wax or cause the glass to break, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 142,740.

title: Huffy Recalls Torex Ride-on Toy UTVs Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The ride-on toy can unexpectedly move when connecting the battery after recharging, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 5,150.

title: Otis Elevator Company Recalls to Inspect Private Residence Elevators Due to Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate, and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 5,000.

title: BRP Recalls Can-Am Screw Jacks Due to Crush Hazard
summary: The screw jack can collapse and cause the lifted vehicle to fall on a person, posing a crush hazard that can result in severe injury or death. Units: About 650 (In addition, about 54 were sold in Canada).

title: Camp Chef Recalls Portable Gas Stoves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal part of the gas regulator component can have a sharp edge that can wear or tear a hole in the seal causing gas to leak out of the top of the regulator, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,600.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Canvas NEO Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front fender can detach and cause the front wheel to abruptly stop, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,270.

title: Graco Recalls Inclined Sleeper Accessory Included with Four Models of Playards to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 51,000.

title: LG Energy Solution Michigan Recalls Home Energy Storage Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The home batteries can overheat, posing a risk of fire and emission of harmful smoke. Units: About 1,815.

title: Homfa Cabinets Recalled Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Made by Shenzhen Luosi Ge Trading Co. (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled cabinets are unstable if not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or serious injuries to children. The cabinets do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM F2057-19). Units: About 6,375.

title: Scentsy Recalls Electrical Oil Warmers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Corrosion of electrical components in Scentsy Luminary Jack Warmers and Scentsy Bless This Home Warmers due to fumigation required to eradicate a cockroach infestation in one of Scentsy's shipping containers poses a fire hazard. Units: About 7,805 in the U.S. (6,940 Luminary Jack and 865 Bless This

title: Thermo Tents Recalls Mór Series Tents Due to Fire Hazard; Tents are Mislabeled as Fire Retardant (Recall Alert)
summary: The tents are incorrectly labeled as being fire retardant (FR), posing a fire hazard. Units: About 260.

title: Black & Decker Recalls CRAFTSMAN 10-Inch Corded Chain Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The chain saw can start unexpectedly without operation of the switch when the extension cord adaptor is connected upside down, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 82,000.

title: Burley Recalls Child Bicycle Seats Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The reclining plate that holds the child bicycle seat in place can detach, making the child seat unstable and can cause the rider of the bicycle to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 780.

title: Fiskars Brands Recalls 16 Foot Pole Saw/Pruners Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The telescoping poles of the pole saw/pruner can separate, causing the poles to come apart and fall down and the saw blade and pruner head to drop, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 467,680 (In addition, about 95,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Goal Zero Recalls Power Supplies Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The connection between the power supply module and the output cord can be loose, causing the electrical connections to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,500.

title: GrillBlazer Recalls Propane Torch Guns Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Propane gas can leak from the GrillBlazer torch, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: L G Sourcing Recalls to Repair Electric Fireplaces Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: Wiring connectors in the fireplace can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 48,000.

title: Neptune Benson Recalls Delta Ultra-Violet Generators For Pools and Spas Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Water can leak within the generator, causing excessive heat build-up in the area where the power cord connects to the body of the generator unit, which can pose a fire hazard. Units: About 4,560.

title: Spirit Halloween Recalls Children's Flashlights Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The batteries in the flashlight can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 6,100 (In addition, about 380 units were sold in Canada).

title: Washington Shoe Company Recalls Western Chief Toddler Boots Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: Rivets used to attach the handles to the boot can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 77,400.

title: Anticimex Recalls SMART Connect Mini Devices Due to Fire and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The device's power supply can overheat while charging, and cause the plastic enclosure to fly off, posing fire and injury hazards. Units: About 2,750.

title: Target Recalls Infant Rompers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps can break or detach from the rompers, posing a choking, laceration and pinching hazards to children. Units: About 299,000.

title: Target Recalls Infant-Toddler Girl's One-Piece Rashguard Swimsuits Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps can break or detach from the suits, posing choking and laceration hazards to children. Units: About 181,000.

title: GSK Consumer Health Recalls Five Excedrin Brands Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: Some of the bottles containing the over-the-counter drug can have a hole in the bottom. If there is a hole, children could access and swallow the contents, posing a risk of poisoning. title: King of Fans Recalls Hampton Bay Mara Ceiling Fans Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The blades can detach from the fan while in use, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 182,000 (In addition, about 8,800 were sold in Canada).

title: Urban Outfitters Recalls Taper Candle Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candle holders can catch on fire if they come in contact with the candle's flame, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,300 (In addition, about 300 in Canada).

title: BRP Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A rear wheel can separate from the vehicle and cause a loss of control, posing a crash hazard to consumers. Units: About 135 (In addition, about 37 were sold in Canada).
